Declaration.Code: bool IsFacing(float dirInRadians) { var facePoint = WoWPoint.RayCast(Me.Location, dirInRadians, 1f); return WoWMathHelper.IsFacing(Me.Location, Me.RenderFacing, facePoint, 0.5f); }

bool NearFire() { return ObjectManager.GetObjectsOfType<WoWGameObject>().Any(o => o.IsValid && o.SubType == WoWGameObjectType.SpellFocus && o.SpellFocus == WoWSpellFocus.CookingFire && o.Distance < 8); }
bool HasLure() { var r = Lua.GetReturnValues("return GetWeaponEnchantInfo()"); return r != null && r.Count > 0 && r[0] == "1"; }

void ApplyBestLure() { uint[] lures = { 6533, 6532, 6530, 6529 }; uint[] reqs = { 100, 100, 50, 0 }; for (int n = 0; n < lures.Length; n++) { if (Fishing.Level < reqs[n]) continue; var lure = Me.BagItems.FirstOrDefault(i => i.IsValid && i.Entry == lures[n]); if (lure == null) continue; Log(System.Drawing.Color.YellowGreen, "Applying {0} to the fishing pole.", lure.Name); Lua.DoString(string.Format("UseContainerItem({0}, {1}) if SpellIsTargeting() then PickupInventoryItem(16) end ClearCursor()", lure.BagIndex + 1, lure.BagSlot + 1)); return; } }

void LearnRecipeFromBag(uint itemId) { var recipe = Me.BagItems.FirstOrDefault(i => i.IsValid && i.Entry == itemId); if (recipe == null) { Log(System.Drawing.Color.Red, "Recipe item {0} is not in the bags.", itemId); return; } Log(System.Drawing.Color.YellowGreen, "Learning {0}.", recipe.Name); recipe.UseContainerItem(); }

void NoBobber() { castsWithoutBobber++; if (castsWithoutBobber < 3) return; castsWithoutBobber = 0; float newFacing = Me.Rotation + 0.7f; if (newFacing > 6.28f) newFacing -= 6.28f; Log(System.Drawing.Color.YellowGreen, "No bobber after 3 casts, probably facing land. void FaceWater(double x, double y, double z) { Log(System.Drawing.Color.YellowGreen, "Facing the water at {0:0}, {1:0}.", x, y); Me.SetFacing(new WoWPoint(x, y, z)); WoWMovement.Move(Styx.WoWInternals.WoWMovement.MovementDirection.ForwardBackMovement); WoWMovement.MoveStop(Styx.WoWInternals.WoWMovement.MovementDirection.ForwardBackMovement); Thread.Sleep(800); castsWithoutBobber = 0; }

void CastRecipe(uint spellId) { var sp = WoWSpell.FromId((int)spellId); if (sp == null) { Log(System.Drawing.Color.Red, "Spell {0} not found in the spell database.", spellId); return; } if (Me.IsMoving) WoWMovement.MoveStop(); sp.Cast(); }

string PbRecipeState() { try { return string.Join(" ", Professionbuddy.Instance.TradeSkillList.Select(ts => ts.Name + ":" + ts.Recipes.Count + "/" + ts.KnownRecipes.Count + "/" + ts.Recipes.ContainsKey(37836u))); } catch (Exception ex) { return ex.Message; } }
